about: Decoded AI scripts of monsters 0x00-0x53 and of the AI heroes (key hero) (tools/export_ai_vm.py). pc = offset from the script base 0x104F15. See docs/monster-ai-opcodes.md.

00.name: ret
00.desc: return: pops the address pushed by CALL; at depth 0 the error handler restarts the script at entry+3

2B.name: rnd_var2
2B.desc: var2 = random 0..(arg & 15), inclusive, uniform (no draw when 0; rejection sampling of the low nibble of the RNG byte)

2C.name: rnd_var3
2C.desc: var3 = random 0..(arg & 15), inclusive, uniform (no draw when 0; rejection sampling of the low nibble of the RNG byte)

2D.name: if_field_and_nz
2D.desc: jump if byte(objref arg1, offset arg2 + 0x180) & arg3 != 0

2E.name: if_field_and_z
2E.desc: jump if byte(objref arg1, offset arg2 + 0x180) & arg3 == 0

2F.name: if_field_lt
2F.desc: jump if byte(objref arg1, offset arg2 + 0x180) < arg3

30.name: if_field_gt
30.desc: jump if byte(objref arg1, offset arg2 + 0x180) > arg3

31.name: if_no_hero_16
31.desc: jump if no valid hero is within 16 px

32.name: if_no_monster_16
32.desc: hero AI: jump if no valid monster (slots 3-5, id < 0x80) is within 16 px

34.name: if_tgt_not_within_16
34.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen and within 16 px

46.name: if_tgt_not_band_64
46.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen and in distance class 8 (49-64 px, or a coordinate offset of 256 or more)

49.name: if_no_hero_32
49.desc: jump if no valid hero is within 32 px

4A.name: if_no_monster_32
4A.desc: hero AI: jump if no valid monster is within 32 px

4C.name: if_tgt_not_within_32
4C.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen and within 32 px

4E.name: if_no_hero_48
4E.desc: jump if no valid hero is within 48 px

4F.name: if_no_monster_48
4F.desc: hero AI: jump if no valid monster is within 48 px

51.name: if_tgt_not_within_48
51.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen and within 48 px

53.name: if_no_hero_64
53.desc: jump if no valid hero is within 64 px

54.name: if_no_ally_64
54.desc: jump if none of the other monster slots 3-5 holds a valid ordinary monster (id < 0x80) within 64 px

56.name: if_tgt_not_within_64
56.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen and within 64 px

58.name: if_no_hero_onscreen
58.desc: jump if no valid hero is on screen

5A.name: if_tgt_not_beyond_64
5A.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen and farther than 64 px (distance class 0x10 or 0x30)

5D.name: tgt_far
5D.desc: current target = first valid hero farther than 64 px (FF if none)

5F.name: if_obj_outside
5F.desc: jump if object ref arg1 is outside the box 8 <= x <= 248, 8 <= y-h <= 216

60.name: if_obj_inside
60.desc: jump if object ref arg1 is inside the box 8 <= x <= 248, 8 <= y-h <= 216

62.name: if_fight
62.desc: hero AI: jump if a valid monster exists and no pad-bound hero ($D9-$DB) is farther than 96 px

66.name: if_tgt_not_lane_v64
66.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen in the vertical lane (|dx| < 16, vertical major axis), within 64 px

68.name: if_tgt_not_lane_v48
68.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen in the vertical lane, within 48 px

6A.name: if_tgt_not_lane_v
6A.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen in the vertical lane, any distance

6F.name: if_tgt_not_lane_h64
6F.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen in the horizontal lane (|dy| < 16, horizontal major axis), within 64 px

71.name: if_tgt_not_lane_h48
71.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen in the horizontal lane, within 48 px

73.name: if_tgt_not_lane_h
73.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen in the horizontal lane, any distance

75.name: if_tgt_not_above
75.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen, above and the vertical axis is the major one

77.name: if_tgt_not_below
77.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen, below and the vertical axis is the major one

79.name: if_tgt_not_left
79.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen, to the left and the horizontal axis is the major one

7B.name: if_tgt_not_right
7B.desc: jump unless the current target is on screen, to the right and the horizontal axis is the major one

85.name: undefined
85.desc: undefined op: the handler is the error handler $C1:0100 (script restarts at entry + 3)

9D.name: if_pos_same
9D.desc: jump if the own screen position equals the saved one

9E.name: if_pos_moved
9E.desc: jump if the own screen position differs from the saved one

9F.name: pos_save
9F.desc: save the own screen position (x, y - h)

A5.name: tgt_within_16
A5.desc: current target = first valid hero within 16 px (FF if none)

A6.name: tgt_monster_16
A6.desc: hero AI: current target = first valid monster (slots 3-5) within 16 px, FF if none

B1.name: tgt_within_32
B1.desc: current target = first valid hero within 32 px (FF if none)

B2.name: tgt_monster_32
B2.desc: hero AI: current target = first valid monster within 32 px

B4.name: tgt_within_48
B4.desc: current target = first valid hero within 48 px (FF if none)

B5.name: tgt_monster_48
B5.desc: hero AI: current target = first valid monster within 48 px

B7.name: tgt_within_64
B7.desc: current target = first valid hero within 64 px (FF if none)

B8.name: tgt_monster_64
B8.desc: hero AI: current target = first valid monster within 64 px

BA.name: if_word_and_nz
BA.desc: jump if word(objref arg1, offset arg2 + 0x180) & word(arg3, arg4) != 0

BB.name: if_word_and_z
BB.desc: jump if word(objref arg1, offset arg2 + 0x180) & word(arg3, arg4) == 0

BC.name: if_word_lt
BC.desc: jump if word(objref arg1, offset arg2 + 0x180) < word(arg3, arg4)

BD.name: if_word_gt
BD.desc: jump if word(objref arg1, offset arg2 + 0x180) > word(arg3, arg4)

BE.name: move_toward_card
BE.desc: as E4 with the cardinal code (horizontal when |dx| >= |dy|)

BF.name: move_away_card
BF.desc: as E6 with the cardinal code

D8.name: tgt2_ally
D8.desc: second target = first such other monster (FF if none)

DF.name: swing_plain
DF.desc: hero AI: gauge +0x1ED == 0: clear flag +0x14C bit 0, command 02 (swing), yield; else continue

E0.name: hop
E0.desc: command C1, direction code arg1, animation arg2, flag arg3; yield

E1.name: follow
E1.desc: hero AI: command 01 (follow the party), yield

E3.name: turn_facing
E3.desc: command C1 in the current facing direction when the actor is not moving (else from the velocity bytes), animation arg1, flag arg2; yield

E4.name: move_toward
E4.desc: if the current target is on screen: command C1 toward it (primary direction), animation arg1, flag arg2; yield (otherwise continue)

E5.name: move_toward2
E5.desc: as E4 with the second target

E6.name: move_away
E6.desc: if the current target is on screen: command C1 away from it (primary direction), animation arg1, flag arg2; yield

E8.name: swing
E8.desc: if the cooldown gauge obj+0x1ED is 0: obj+0x19B = obj+0x1C0, command 02; yield (otherwise continue)

E9.name: cast
E9.desc: cast attack/spell arg2 with animation arg1 on the second target if it is on screen, MP obj+0x186 >= cost of attack arg2, not confused and obj+0x60 != E0: command 44, calls $C0:001B; else command C1 in the facing direction, animation 0, flag 5; yield

EA.name: cast_all
EA.desc: cast attack/spell arg2 with animation arg1 on a whole side: MP obj+0x186 >= cost, or obj+0x60 != E0 and not confused; second target < 3: slots 0-2 when hero 0 is valid, else slots 3-5 when slot 3 holds a valid monster that is not this one; command 44 (targets +1 in obj+0x178..0x17A, count in obj+0x176), calls $C0:001B; else command C1 in the facing direction, animation 0, flag 5; yield

EF.name: cmd81
EF.desc: command 81 with arguments arg1, arg2; yield

F2.name: if_charge_set
F2.desc: hero AI: arg 0: jump if the charge setting $CC7D + slot is above the stage +0x19B; arg != 0: jump if it is not

F3.name: charge_start
F3.desc: hero AI: charge setting $CC7D + slot != 0 and flag +0x14C bit 0 clear: set the flag, command 06 (hold the attack button), yield; else continue

F4.name: charge_release
F4.desc: hero AI: flag +0x14C bit 0 set: clear it, command 07 (release the attack button), yield; else continue

F5.name: if_crowd_gt
F5.desc: jump if more than arg of the monster slots 3-5 (this one included) are active and on screen

FC.name: flash
FC.desc: toggle the palette flash bytes obj+0x1E3 / 0x1E4 and call $C0:003C (only when obj+0x191 & 0xDF == 0); continue

FD.name: move_toward_alt
FD.desc: as E4 with the alternate direction (always a diagonal code)

FE.name: move_away_alt
FE.desc: as E6 with the alternate direction

FF.name: call
FF.desc: call the 16-bit big-endian address; pushes pc+3; the error handler runs when the depth would reach 16
